captions.detailed: A black, garage-gym scale flat-incline utility bench featuring a dark metal rectangular frame base. It is equipped with a rectangular backrest pad, a smaller matching seat pad, and a rear adjustment ladder support made of silver cylindrical rungs. For mobility, it includes two small black wheels at the front base with a projecting square-profile carry handle, allowing the entire bench to be easily rolled and adjusted.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an adjustable incline utility bench with a rectangular steel base frame, front wheels, a protruding front carry handle, a hinged seat pad, and an adjustable backrest supported by a rear ladder mechanism.
captions.factory: The code constructs the bench by first building a rectangular base frame with crossmembers, diagonal bracing, and a front-mounted handle using Box and Cylinder primitives. It adds two front wheels on a cylindrical axle. It then creates the seat pad and backrest pad assemblies using Box shapes mounted on steel support brackets. A rear adjustment ladder is built with cylindrical rungs connected by side rails, which is hinged to the backrest bracket, allowing the backrest to rotate around a horizontal pivot axis.
